messages:
maggie: Heads-up: board wants a clear "margin guardrail" for the roadmap section. We need rules for list prices, addon caps, approved discount flows, and launch gating. Need agreement by EOD.

priya: My take: public list + a documented override process. For add-ons, we should publish tiered limits (Basic/Pro/Enterprise) with clear unit caps to avoid unexpected infra costs.

kevin: Ops note: tiered limits need enforcement in the rate-limiter and quota service. Also require per-tenant effective cap field in billing so Finance can reject overage charges automatically.

dmitri: From product: launch gating should require three things: (1) pricing stress test against three customer archetypes, (2) billing can represent prorations & effective prices, (3) sales playbook + sample amendment.

legal-bot: Legal: overrides must be documented with approver chain + signed amendment. Recommend 150d notice for public price increases and 120d for addon sunsetting for enterprise.

priya: Suggest we also have a "safety discount cap" table: e.g., up to 15% AE-only; 15-40% RevOps; >40% RevOps+Legal. That prevents ad-hoc deep discounts.

kevin: Agree on the cap table. I'll scope infra changes: quota enforcement, billing fields (list_price, effective_price, override_ticket, expiry_date), and a Console banner when effective != list.

maggie: Owners: priya -> margin guardrail doc + tier limits table, kevin -> infra + billing tickets, dmitri -> launch gating checklist + pricing stress tests, legal-bot -> amendment templates & approval matrix. sales-bot please create enablement ticket.

sales-bot: ticket created: #8801 "Margin guardrails: tier limits, override matrix, and sales playbook" 4xx. Assignees: priya, kevin, dmitri. ETA 2025-04-10.

priya: Also propose a short-lived pilot: open overrides only for named beta customers for 60 days so Sales can test amendment flow; require post-pilot review.

dmitri: Pilot sounds good. Add telemetry to measure margin delta, frequency of overrides, and any fallout in latency/cost.

kevin: We'll add a Console dashboard tile and an alert for when margin delta > 20% for any tenant.

legal-bot: I'll produce two amendment templates: standard and expedited (for time-sensitive procurement). Expedited still needs RevOps signoff.

maggie: OK I'll write the roadmap blurb: public list + tier caps, override matrix with named approvers + amendment requirement, 120/150 day notice windows, pilot for beta overrides, infra+console changes, and telemetry. Merge by EOD unless objections.

priya: No objections here.

dmitri: LGTM.

kevin: Good with infra plan.

legal-bot: No objections from legal.
